message.content: {"tender_id": "ERP-PROC-2026-08", "page_number": 6, "clauses": [{"clauseType": "FINANCIAL_TURNOVER", "comparator": "MIN_REQUIRED", "rawValue": "100.00", "unit": "INR_CRORE", "pageNumber": 6, "verbatimQuote": "Average Annual Turnover from ERP & similar work in last three (3) financial years ending 31.03.2019 should be minimum INR 100 Crores per year and Net-Worth should be positive as on 31.03.2019"}, {"clauseType": "NET_WORTH", "comparator": "MIN_REQUIRED", "rawValue": "1.00", "unit": "INR_CRORE", "pageNumber": 6, "verbatimQuote": "Net-Worth should be positive as on 31.03.2019"}, {"clauseType": "PAST_EXPERIENCE", "comparator": "MIN_REQUIRED", "rawValue": "2", "unit": "PROJECTS", "pageNumber": 6, "verbatimQuote": "The bidder should have implemented at least 2 (Two) Educational ERP system for the University in India involving support, maintenance and services also."}, {"clauseType": "ISO_CERTIFICATION", "comparator": "REQUIRED_SET", "rawValue": "ISO/IEC 27001", "unit": "BOOLEAN", "pageNumber": 6, "verbatimQuote": "The bidder must have at least valid ISO/IEC 27001 certificate for software standards and at least CMMi level 3 certification for Software  Design, Development & Testing"}, {"clauseType": "EARNEST_MONEY_DEPOSIT", "comparator": "MAX_ALLOWED", "rawValue": "4.50", "unit": "INR_LAKH", "pageNumber": 6, "verbatimQuote": "Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of INR 4.50 Lakhs shall be submitted via BG/DD."}, {"clauseType": "LIQUIDATED_DAMAGES", "comparator": "MAX_ALLOWED", "rawValue": "10.00", "unit": "PERCENT", "pageNumber": 6, "verbatimQuote": "Liquidated damages for delayed delivery and SLA breach shall be capped at 10% of total contract value."}]}
